source_name: FinTech Roadmap (Brno/Praha) – annual CZ/SK fintech conference
why_relevant: Described as the largest CZ/SK fintech conference (2026 edition at the ČNB Congress Centre, 400+ attendees, 40+ speakers) drawing founders, investors, bankers and regulators. Speaker rosters carry startup founder and bank-innovation-lead titles that rarely appear elsewhere; historic editions since 2022 are documented.

source_name: FinTech Cowboys – Czech fintech news & event coverage
why_relevant: The de-facto chronicler of the CZ fintech scene: covers conferences, meetups and personnel news and names the people involved. Best used as a pointer that reveals which events exist, who spoke, and which new fintech actors to add to the actor map.

source_name: Retail Summit (Blue Events) – programme & speaker roster
why_relevant: 80+ speakers a year across CZ retail, including retail-banking, payments-acceptance and loyalty executives, each listed with title and employer; editions run annually (2024: 85 speakers; 2025: 70+; 2026: March 10–12). Relevant to the payments-acceptance/merchant side of the sector, which pure banking conferences miss.

source_name: Blue Events – conference portfolio index
why_relevant: Organiser index covering Retail Summit, New Retail Summit (SK) and adjacent B2B conferences. A single pointer that enumerates which senior-audience events exist each year and where their speaker pages live, including cross-border CZ/SK editions.

source_name: IT ve finančnictví – Přednášející (speakers) page
why_relevant: 12th annual edition (23 Sep 2026, Hotel Grandior Praha) focused on DORA/NIS2, cybersecurity and financial-sector IT. The 'přednášející' page names CIO/CISO/IT-security roles at banks and vendors — the technology-organisation layer that business conferences do not expose. Long-running series with per-year archives.

source_name: Trendy v platebním styku ČR & SR (organised by CGI IT Czech Republic)
why_relevant: Annual CZ/SK payments-operations conference (Majestic Plaza Praha) on SEPA Instant, QR payments, Verification of Payee, PSD3/PSR. Its speaker list is the working payments-operations layer of banks — heads of payments, product owners — a population invisible in press releases but decisive for payments-org mapping.

source_name: konferenceseminare.cz – Czech B2B event aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator of Czech professional conferences and seminars including the banking/payments track. Use it to enumerate the long tail of smaller, single-topic events whose speaker lists are rich in mid-level bank titles and which no single organiser index would surface.

source_name: Časopis Bankovnictví – Eventy (events section)
why_relevant: The Czech banking trade magazine's event calendar and event coverage. Doubles as a pointer to the sector's event calendar and as a direct source when it reports speaker line-ups and award ceremonies with names and titles. Trade-press framing often makes the role change explicit ('nový ředitel', 've funkci od').

source_name: FIN (R)Evoluce – Měšec.cz annual financial-innovation conference
why_relevant: 11th edition (Hotel Jalta, Praha), run by consumer-finance server Měšec.cz with moderator Dalibor Z. Chvátal. Speaker line-ups skew to product and digital-channel leads at banks, insurers and fintechs; multiple independent media recaps (Měšec, Euro.cz, Ekonomický magazín) name the speakers, giving redundant capture when the event page itself is thin.

source_name: Zlatý měšec – Měšec.cz consumer finance award
why_relevant: Long-running CZ award ranking banks and credit unions. The award ceremony and its expert/voting panel put named bank representatives on record, and winners' pages on bank sites (e.g. RSTS ocenění page) mirror the results. Weaker on jury naming than Zlatá koruna, so treat as a secondary corroborator and an actor-map feed.

source_name: VŠE Praha – Rozvoj a inovace finančních produktů conference (FFÚ / Katedra bankovnictví a pojišťovnictví)
why_relevant: The canonical CZ university-industry panel: 13+ annual editions, held under ČNB-governor patronage, with panels naming sitting CEOs and board members (12th edition panel: Tomáš Salomon, Jan Juchelka, Tomáš Nidetzky, Andrea Ferjenčíková). Academic sites archive announcements and reports indefinitely, giving a durable free time series of who held which seat in a given year.

source_name: ČNB – Vystoupení, konference, semináře (speeches & conferences archive)
why_relevant: The central bank publishes, with a deep archive, who spoke where and in what capacity — including board members and senior supervisors at industry conferences. Also hosts the '30 let ČNB' conference page with 'Medailonky diskutujících' (participant bios), an explicit named-role census. Authoritative and highly structured.

source_name: Banking Innovation Forum & Expo (Cubex Centrum Praha listing)
why_relevant: A long-running (17th+ edition) banking-innovation forum held in Prague. The venue's event listing is a reliable pointer to the edition, dates and organiser even when the organiser's own site is short-lived; venue pages also enumerate other finance events at the same site.

source_name: Treasury Fórum (O2 universum Praha)
why_relevant: Conference for corporate treasury specialists plus the banks and payment-service providers serving them. Speaker and panel lists expose bank transaction-banking / cash-management leadership — a named layer directly adjacent to payments that no other event in this cell covers.

source_name: Economia events (events-economia.cz / events.economia.cz)
why_relevant: The events arm of the publisher of Hospodářské noviny runs finance-sector conferences (e.g. 'Inovace v platebních kartách', TOP realitní fondy) with dedicated 'Řečníci' pages listing names and titles. A single organiser pointer covering several payments/finance events with consistent speaker-page structure.

source_name: Česká fintech asociace (czechfintech.cz) – events section
why_relevant: Industry association listing fintech-sector events (e.g. Finanční konference editions). Association event pages and member listings reveal which fintechs exist and who represents them publicly — a compact actor-map feed feeding the rest of this cell.

source_name: Finanční konference (financnikonference.cz)
why_relevant: Recurring CZ finance conference whose 2026 speaker list names bank chief economists and market figures with employer (Helena Horská / Raiffeisenbank, David Navrátil / Česká spořitelna, Petr Koblic / Burza cenných papírů Praha, Vít Endler / finGood). Chief-economist seats are a stable, easily-diffed role class.

source_name: Fintree.cz – Czech fintech media, event previews and recaps
why_relevant: Covers CZ fintech conferences with speaker detail (e.g. the FinTech Roadmap 2026 preview naming venue, scale and speaker count). Useful redundancy when organiser sites are JS-rendered or taken down after the event.

source_name: Cashless Future conference site
why_relevant: Cashless-payments conference site surfaced in cs search; its programme/contacts sections name organisers and speakers on the cashless/acceptance side. Latest confirmed edition observed is 2022, so it may be dormant — value is mainly as an archived roster for back-dating roles, and it must be re-checked before being treated as live.

source_name: 10times – Prague banking/payments event listings
why_relevant: International event aggregator with per-event pages, edition histories and organiser links for Prague finance/retail events. Useful for discovering editions and dates in a structured, machine-readable way; not a source of speaker titles itself.

source_name: Odborový svaz pracovníků peněžnictví a pojišťovnictví (OSPPP) — official site
why_relevant: The single sector trade union covering banks, insurers and health insurers in CZ; unites ~150 basic union organisations (ZO) across 27+ employers. Its Aktuality feed and documents section are the primary place where restructuring, redundancy and collective-bargaining disputes in Czech banks become public before/independently of employer PR.

source_name: OSPPP — page listing basic union organisations by employer (odborové organizace)
why_relevant: Actor map: enumerates which Czech banks/insurers actually have a ZO (union presence) and gives contact points. This is the seed list for monitoring firm-level union communications and for knowing where a collective-redundancy consultation is legally required to happen.

source_name: ČMKOS — Českomoravská konfederace odborových svazů (union confederation)
why_relevant: Parent confederation of OSPPP. Publishes positions, legal guidance and campaign material on mass redundancies, labour-code changes and works-council/European-Works-Council rights; escalation venue when a bank restructuring becomes political.

source_name: Sondy Revue — ČMKOS trade-union magazine
why_relevant: Monthly union magazine (15,000 print run) covering labour disputes, redundancy practice and sectoral bargaining from the workers' side. Useful for narrative/commentary on bank downsizing that the employer will not publish; OSPPP explicitly links it as a member channel.

source_name: Úřad práce ČR (ÚP ČR) — statistics portal, incl. mass-redundancy notifications
why_relevant: Employers must notify the regional ÚP branch of hromadné propouštění under the Labour Code (§62, employers with 20+ staff). ÚP has historically issued press releases and regional/annual reports counting notifications, affected headcount and sector breakdown — i.e. the legally-forced disclosure of downsizing that firms do not announce. Note: the site moved to the up.gov.cz domain in Feb 2026 (old uradprace.cz / mpsv.cz/up-cz paths may redirect).

source_name: MPSV Open Data Portal (data.mpsv.cz) — labour market datasets
why_relevant: Since Jan 2025 all MPSV/ÚP labour statistics are consolidated here as open data with Power BI presentations. Machine-readable route to unemployment, vacancy and (potentially) mass-redundancy series that can be sliced by region and industry — the structural backbone for detecting finance-sector workforce contraction.

source_name: MPSV — Příručka pro personální agendu (ppropo.mpsv.cz), section on hromadné propouštění
why_relevant: Authoritative statement of the legal procedure: thresholds, who must be notified, what must be reported to the ÚP and to the union/works council, and timing. Defines exactly which paper trail exists and when — essential for knowing what to look for and when a restructuring becomes legally visible.

source_name: Zákoník práce č. 262/2006 Sb. — Díl 6 Hromadné propouštění; Část dvanáctá (informování a projednání, rada zaměstnanců)
why_relevant: The statute itself: defines mass redundancy thresholds and the mandatory information/consultation duties toward the union organisation, works council (rada zaměstnanců, 3–15 elected members) and the Labour Office. Legal anchor for every other source in this cell.

source_name: Český statistický úřad (ČSÚ) — banking & insurance sector statistics methodology and data
why_relevant: Official statistics on the finance & insurance sector (NACE section K): employee counts, average wages, quarterly financial indicators for ČNB-supervised banks and non-bank financial institutions. Detects headcount contraction in the sector even when no single firm announces it.

source_name: ČSÚ — Statistika&My magazine (analytical commentary on employment/wages)
why_relevant: ČSÚ's own analytical channel; publishes readable breakdowns such as employment change in banking and insurance (e.g. '+1.1 thousand employees, +1.6%') and wage-distribution analyses by sector — turns raw tables into trackable sector narratives.
